compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald (the book's term for Terrestrial Circle sorcery), printed p. 101-102 (PDF 102-103). Savant and Sorcerer's own introduction states this chapter supersedes Book of Three Circles' Terrestrial/Celestial spell lists as the current catalog.

name: Blood Lash
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell usable only while already lethally wounded; turns the caster's own blood and pain into a whip-like weapon that grows deadlier the more hurt he is.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. The caster must have already suffered at least one unhealed level of lethal damage to cast this spell, paying 10 motes plus one additional level of lethal damage (a committed cost that does not trigger reflexive Charms and does not heal while the spell is active). Forms a whip of animated blood, part of the sorcerer's own body (cannot be disarmed), with Speed equal to the caster's Occult score and +1 accuracy/+1 defense; the caster attacks with Dexterity + Melee, dealing base lethal damage equal to Strength + permanent Essence + the number of lethal health levels currently suffered. Range is in yards equal to the caster's Willpower. The caster must concentrate to maintain the whip, so no other spells may be cast while wielding it, though Charms function normally. Lasts one scene or until dispelled/countered.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 102 (PDF 103).

name: Burning Eyes of the Offender
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that charges the caster's anima into a fearsome visage, punishing any enemy within 100 yards who looks at her with pain and weeping and making her harder to hit.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 10 motes, a single word and gesture cause all enemies within 100 yards who look upon the caster to have their eyes sear with pain and weep uncontrollably; for 10 minutes, all attacks against the caster made by affected enemies suffer a difficulty penalty equal to her permanent Essence (enemies entering the area afterward are affected too, but those attacking from beyond the spell's range suffer no penalty). A character may instead fight with eyes closed to avoid the penalty, but takes the normal -2 blindness penalty unless she has a Charm or magic negating the need for vision. The caster appears glorious to everyone, in or out of range. She may dispel the spell reflexively at any time; only enemies are affected, whether or not the caster was aware of them.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 102 (PDF 103).

name: Calling the Wind's Kiss
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that conjures a magical wind to speed one sailing vessel's passage or to curse and hinder an enemy ship, out to a range scaling with the caster's Essence.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One sailing vessel within visual range, up to (permanent Essence x 3) miles away. For 10 motes the wind lasts a number of hours equal to the caster's permanent Essence; it can be extended at 2 motes/hour (paid up front or renewed hourly), to a maximum of 20 additional motes. Benevolent casting: the targeted ship's sails fill with wind, letting it hold maximum speed through normal currents/small storms (heavy storms/sorcerous currents/obstacles still hinder it) and granting +3 dice to Sail rolls in extreme conditions. Hostile casting: the wind blows counter to the ship's heading no matter which way it turns, forcing it to sail as if tacking, and imposes a -3 die penalty to Sail rolls to control the ship. Countered by countermagic or by casting Calling the Wind's Kiss in opposition; a spirit of the air with permanent Essence >= the caster's may seize control of the spell with a Willpower roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence); the caster can dismiss the spell at will unless a spirit has commandeered it.
cost: 10 motes + 2 motes per additional hour (maximum 20 additional motes)
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 102-103 (PDF 103-104).

name: Commanding the Beasts
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that lets the caster seize control of a number of ordinary animals nearby, forcing them to obey her will for a scene.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Nearby animals of animal intelligence (Intelligence 1 only -- has no effect on Wyld-shaped, magical, automaton, plant, undead, elemental or possessed creatures). For 10 motes the caster subjugates a number of animals within 20 yards equal to her permanent Essence x 2, for one scene unless countered (by Emerald Countermagic, an equivalent spell, beast-calming Charms, or another casting of Commanding the Beasts, which simply negates the first). The caster's player adds +3 dice to Survival or Presence rolls to deal with the commanded creatures; if she does not tame them by the spell's end, they revert to their pre-spell state. Other characters interacting with the animals need a successful Charisma + Ride or Charisma + Survival roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence). Charms or sorcery affect the creatures normally.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 103 (PDF 104).

name: Conjuring the Azure Chariot
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that summons an elemental horse-drawn chariot -- fast, nearly indestructible, and daylight-only -- to fly the caster and cargo to a chosen destination.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 15 motes, summons four cerulean elemental horses towing an azure chariot with room for the caster plus 200 lbs of goods/people per point of permanent Essence. Can only be cast during daylight; flies at 200 mph (~600 yards/turn) to a chosen destination, landing to let passengers unload (one minute) if the sun sets before arrival. The chariot has 25 health levels, soak 25L/35B, provides 90% hard cover to riders (only one attack per turn can target it or its occupants unless matched in flight), and grants +3 dice to Ride rolls made flying it through extreme weather. Lasts until it reaches its destination, is commanded to land, the sun sets, or it is countered.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 103 (PDF 104).

name: Corrupted Words
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that curses a target so she can never again speak of a chosen subject, on pain of helplessly vomiting maggots if she tries.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature within 10 yards, requiring eye contact at casting. For 10 motes, the caster names a subject the victim can never speak of again. Exalted and physically manifested spirits may resist with a Stamina + Resistance roll (difficulty = caster's Occult); may also be parried or dodged with Charms. Any attempt to speak of (or hedge around, or code-speak about) the forbidden subject causes the victim to vomit white maggots, crippling and immobilizing her (only reflexive Charms usable) while it happens. Lasts until broken by countermagic or the caster's death.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 103-104 (PDF 104-105).

name: Curse of Slavish Humility
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that forces a victim to grovel in abasement before the caster or a chosen subject, and to act in a groveling manner even when otherwise acting normally, such as attacking.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature within 10 yards. For 10 motes, ruby tendrils of Essence force the victim to his knees to grovel and abase himself before the caster or a nearby subject; this does not stop the victim from attacking that subject if he chooses, but obliges him to do so in a browbeaten, apologetic manner (no combat effect, but potentially devastating socially). The victim's player may resist with a Charisma + Occult roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence); on failure, the victim suffers a -3 penalty to all Social Attribute rolls for the scene (negatable via social stunts).
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 104 (PDF 105).

name: Dance of the Smoke Cobras
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that conjures five magical venomous smoke cobras bound to relentlessly hunt and strike a single target until it dies or the spell ends.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature within 30 yards. For 15 motes, five smoke cobra conjurations (Strength 3, Dexterity 6, Stamina 4, Brawl 6, Dodge 6, Bite: Speed 8 Accuracy 12 Damage 5L plus venom, Soak 2L/4B, Essence 1; mindless automatons that never dodge or split actions and share one initiative) erupt from the ground and attack only the spell's target, automatically finding it even if it hides; they cannot be evaded by leaving the area (they simply give chase up to 3 yards from their point of origin, striking until the target is out of range). Venom resistance factor equals the caster's permanent Essence (difficulty; success 1L, failure 2L, duration/penalty 3 minutes/-6, per the venom table); magical poison immunity/protection wards against it. Destroyed cobras regrow on their next action. Lasts until the spell ends, at which point the cobras dissolve without a trace.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 104-105 (PDF 105-106), including the Smoke Cobra stat block and Venom Type table split across the PDF 105/106 page break. name: Disguise of the New Face
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that weaves a complete illusory disguise -- appearance, voice, mannerisms and even anima -- onto a willing, immobile target over a 10-minute working.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature (who must stand still while the caster works). For 15 motes and 10 minutes of casting (not a ritual; requires only a small hand loom), the caster weaves Essence threads into a tapestry image of the intended disguise, which then melts into the target's body as a full new visage covering appearance, voice, mannerisms and anima. The caster's player makes an Intelligence + Larceny roll, adding successes equal to the caster's Occult; total successes set the disguise's detail and ability to fool observers per the standard Exalted disguise rules.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 105 (PDF 106).

name: Emerald Circle Banishment
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that banishes a First Circle demon back to Malfeas through a contested Willpower + Essence battle of wills, as a fast alternative to hunting the demon down.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One First Circle demon. A very fast spell (like Emerald Countermagic) that activates as soon as Terrestrial Circle Sorcery is invoked and Willpower spent, for a base 10+ motes. The caster enters a contested Willpower + Essence roll-off against the demon each turn; the caster may spend Essence in 5-mote increments to lower the demon's dice pool by one die per increment. Whoever first accumulates the opponent's permanent Essence in successes wins: if the demon wins, it remains free and the caster cannot retry against it for five days; if the caster wins, the demon is ejected to Malfeas. Sapphire and Adamant Circle versions exist for banishing Second/Third Circle demons (15 and 20 motes respectively); using a higher-Circle banishment against a lower-Circle demon grants three automatic successes on the first roll (Adamant vs. First Circle succeeds automatically).
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 105-106 (PDF 106-107).

name: Eye of Alliance
summary: Terrestrial Circle ritual that links a group's emotions through matching crystals for a year and a day, letting bearers silently send simple emotions to one another and know if a bearer dies.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Participants (up to the caster's permanent Essence x 2), who link hands with the caster for a half-hour incantation. Cost: 5 motes per participant, plus 1 mote committed per crystal created. Creates a faceted crystal per participant (a year-and-a-day duration, or until destroyed); any bearer may send a simple emotion (fear, love, happiness, hatred, sadness, loneliness) to the others, who instantly know the sender's identity, though not what caused the emotion. The crystals cannot be used to locate bearers but make excellent divination foci. If a bearer dies, her crystal dissolves and one facet on every remaining crystal turns black, alerting all bearers to the death. Only ritual participants can send emotions, but the sorcerous nature of a crystal can be discerned and exploited as an arcane link by anyone who identifies it.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 105 (PDF 106); creates an arcane link per the source's own callout box on arcane links (PDF p. 116/printed p. 115), which is folded into this row's notes rather than split into a separate reference row since it is general sorcery background text rather than a discrete mechanic.

name: Flight of Separation
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that instantly transforms the caster into a flock of birds, fast and evasive but unable to fight or use Charms, for a short flight.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 10 motes, at the end of the turn cast, the caster explodes into a flock of birds (number equal to permanent Essence + health levels x 10) that flies at 20 mph for up to a number of miles equal to her permanent Essence before reverting. She retains all Attributes, Abilities, Willpower, health levels, Virtues and soak (including armor) and adds permanent Essence to her Dodge; she may only move and dodge (no Charms, attacks, parries or communication), though she can slip through narrow gaps one bird at a time. Damage taken in bird form is represented by dying birds; wounds manifest visibly on her body upon reverting. Bird coloration/species reflects the caster's nature (Abyssals reportedly manifest as raiton murders). A character with Occult may make a Perception + Occult roll (difficulty 3) to estimate the caster's permanent Essence from the flock's size.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 106 (PDF 107).

name: Flight of the Brilliant Raptor
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that summons a fire elemental in the shape of a blazing bird of prey to streak across nearly a mile and explode on impact with a chosen target.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature within 1,800 yards (~1 mile) and visible to the caster. For 10 motes, the caster's reflexive Wits + Occult roll serves as the attack roll (unparryable without Charms, dodge-only); base lethal damage equals Perception + Occult, with automatic successes equal to permanent Essence, plus roll successes. Impact also ignites a fiery explosion engulfing everything within 3 yards. For every 2 health levels dealt, the target suffers a one-die penalty to Dexterity rolls next turn, decreasing by one each subsequent turn. Everyone within the 3-yard blast (including the original target) must make a Stamina + Resistance roll (difficulty 3) or suffer a two-die penalty to Physical Attribute rolls for two turns as flames catch; the explosion can also ignite nearby flammables/explosives.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 106-107 (PDF 107-108).

name: Flying Guillotine
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that conjures a spinning loop of razor chain that chases down and attempts to decapitate a chosen target at very high speed.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature within line of sight, up to 500 yards. For 10 motes, the caster's reflexive Perception + Occult roll (with automatic successes equal to permanent Essence) is the attack; normal environmental penalties apply but cover bonuses do not, since the guillotine chases and turns corners at 500 yards/turn (~340 mph). Base damage 18L plus roll successes; if damage dealt exceeds the target's remaining health levels, the victim is decapitated and dies instantly rather than merely reaching Incapacitated. A successfully dodged, parried, or countered attack makes the guillotine vanish in a flash of silver light.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 107 (PDF 108).

name: Food from the Aerial Table
summary: Terrestrial Circle ritual that conjures bland but nourishing magical food from the air, enough for five servings per casting, scalable with extra time and Essence.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: N/A (area around the caster). For 10 motes, conjures enough petal-like flakes of textureless food for five servings, appearing the turn after casting. The caster may invest an extra turn and 5 motes (paid up front) per additional 10 servings; interrupting the casting keeps only the food already conjured. The food lasts a number of days equal to the caster's permanent Essence before turning to ash, cannot rot or be poisoned before then, and can sustain creatures indefinitely with enough water, though carnivores tire of it and most creatures eventually need real food -- after years of reliance, the substance stops satisfying hunger, and going without ordinary food for a year imposes a cumulative one-die penalty to all actions until a full normal meal is eaten.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 107 (PDF 108).

name: Fugue of Truth
summary: Terrestrial Circle meditative ritual that leaves the caster stunned and socially slow but grants strong bonuses to spotting magical deception, mundane lies, and the purpose of First Age artifacts.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 10 motes and an hour meditating in a lightless, soundless place, the caster enters a trance mechanically similar to being stunned: -2 to attacking, dodging and any Athletics-based maneuver, and -1 to Social Attribute rolls. In exchange, her player adds +4 dice to Perception rolls detecting magical deception, +3 dice to Perception rolls detecting non-magical lies/bluffs, and +2 dice to rolls determining the purpose of First Age artifacts. If targeted by a mind-affecting spell while in the trance, she may make a reflexive Perception + Resistance roll (difficulty = the attacker's permanent Essence) to resist. The trance ends if the caster botches any roll, is wounded, or voluntarily leaves it; it can only be countered during the casting ritual itself.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 107-108 (PDF 108-109).

name: The Horse That Travels Earth and Water
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that summons an air elemental in the form of a tireless magical warhorse, colored by the caster's proximity to an elemental pole, that serves willingly until sunrise.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One summoned creature. For 10 motes, summons an elemental stallion (colored per the caster's regional elemental pole) that serves willingly until the next sunrise, riding on a gust of wind. It never tires, crosses water as easily as land, carries the caster, gear, and one more rider, never fails Valor checks, but balks at pack-animal duty; if a substitute rider dismounts or falls, the stallion rides on and dematerializes. Stat block: Strength 6, Dexterity 5, Stamina 5; Bite Speed 7 Accuracy 9 Damage 6L Defense 6, Kick Speed 4 Accuracy 7 Damage 8L Defense 7; Dodge 7; Soak 5L/5B (3L/0B unarmored); Willpower 6; Essence 2, Essence pool 52; Charm: Principle of Motion; Elemental Power: Rejuvenation; the caster cannot dematerialize but can force the horse to do so; it only uses its own Charms in self-defense.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.

name: Hound of the Five Winds
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that sculpts a horse-sized magical wolfhound automaton from the five elemental winds, an unstoppable supernatural tracker that serves for up to eight hours.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One conjured automaton. For 15 motes, creates a hound that serves for up to eight hours as a warrior, bodyguard, or mount, and can lead or take control of a pack of trained war dogs. It automatically succeeds at tracking mortal prey and can scent a target up to 100 miles away; it tracks Charm-using prey with a Perception + Survival roll (difficulty = the Charm user's permanent Essence, unless stated otherwise), and only total scent-removal effects meaningfully hinder it (even then it resumes the chase if the effect lapses within 100 miles). Stat block: Strength 5, Dexterity 6, Stamina 5; Bite Speed 9 Accuracy 12 Damage 7L Defense 9; Dodge 9; Soak 7L/7B (5L/2B unarmored); Essence 1. Can only be countered during casting; once formed it must be killed or banished, and it explodes on death or at the spell's end for 5 bashing health levels to everything within 3 yards; it cannot be healed.

name: Hypnotic Piping
summary: Terrestrial Circle two-part spell: a ritual that crafts a set of enchanted bone pipes with a limited number of uses, then a later activation whose music enthralls listeners and lets the sorcerer issue one obeyed command.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: see text. Ritual (21 motes, several hours, begun at moonrise): crafts bone pipes from a hybroc or other immense bird (Intelligence + Craft roll, difficulty 3), which gain a number of amethyst jewels equal to the caster's permanent Essence, each representing one use and each committing 3 motes of the ritual's Essence until used/shattered; only the ritual's caster may use the pipes. Activation (10 motes, no preparatory turn or Willpower needed): playing for up to five turns enthralls sentient beings within a quarter mile, cracking one jewel when finished; the player then issues one command. Mortals resist with a Willpower roll (difficulty = turns played, max 5). Exalts/elementals/spirits get a Wits + Occult roll (difficulty 3) to recognize the enchantment, then a reflexive Willpower roll (difficulty = turns played) to ignore it; failing that roll means they know they were enchanted but must still obey (within limits). No effect on the undead, automata, or Intelligence <2 creatures. Effects wear off after a day and night, leaving dreamlike memories. Interruption nullifies the effect and loses a jewel + Essence; being attacked while playing lets the caster abort to dodge (breaking the spell) or continue by making a Stamina + Resistance roll (difficulty = damage taken). When all jewels are spent, the pipes crumble to bone powder.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 109 (PDF 110).

name: Incantation of Spiritual Discretion
summary: Terrestrial Circle ritual that wards an area against dematerialized beings, preventing Dematerialize and shadow-form entry, for a duration scaling with the caster's Occult and Essence.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: An area with radius in yards equal to the caster's Occult + permanent Essence. For 20+ motes and a six-hour ritual marking the boundary with a line of salt (removable afterward), dematerialized beings (including those using sorcerous shadow-form effects) cannot enter or become dematerialized within the area; Essence cannot be spent to dematerialize inside it (and is not wasted trying). Cannot be cast at a sanctum or while any spirit is present, and has no effect on beings with permanent Essence greater than the caster's. Lasts a number of days equal to Occult + permanent Essence; renewable at any point via a shortened one-hour ritual and repaying the 20 motes.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 109 (PDF 110).

name: Internal Flame
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that transmutes a target's bone marrow to boiling iron from within, dealing continuing agony damage and a lasting wound penalty, usually fatal to mortals without powerful healing.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature, requiring line of sight within 300 yards. For 15 motes, the caster's reflexive Willpower + Occult roll (difficulty = target's Stamina) is an unparryable-except-by-Charm, undodgeable attack; on success it deals base 3L plus roll successes, soaked only by natural soak (armor bonuses ignored, though soak-boosting Charms apply). On any successful damage, 1L/turn continues for a number of turns equal to the caster's permanent Essence, or until the victim receives medical attention (Intelligence + Medicine, difficulty 3). Regardless of resistance, the pain imposes a -2 wound penalty (stacking with existing wound penalties) for the rest of the scene, affecting even those normally immune to wound penalties from other sources. Mortals without potent regenerative healing (e.g. Healing Trance Meditation) will die within a month; Exalts, spirits and fey recover normally.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 109-110 (PDF 110-111).

name: Lightning Spider
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that grows eight insubstantial lightning legs from the caster, letting her climb any surface at normal speed and optionally extend a solid dragline of coherent lightning.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 10+ motes, eight three-yard lightning legs let the caster move along any surface (walls, ceilings, rough terrain) at her normal rate; the legs are insubstantial (pass through objects, cannot be dislodged, are harmless to living things beyond a slight static tingle) and add +5 dice to the caster's Strength check for resisting clinch maneuvers. For additional Essence (up to the caster's permanent Essence in extra motes), she can also produce a solid electric dragline able to support 100 lbs per additional mote spent, usable to bind objects or people; the dragline has soak 10L/10B and 15 health levels before being severed.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 110 (PDF 111).

name: Manifestations of Vigorous Design
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that animates a small inanimate object with a semblance of life and one or more granted Abilities, letting it obey simple commands fitting its nature.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One inanimate, simple, nonmechanical object weighing up to 10 lbs per point of the caster's permanent Essence. For a committed 5+ motes (touching the object), it animates and obeys simple commands fitting its nature/design (a broom sweeps, a table walks, a toy soldier marches, a ball bounces). Physical Attributes = one dot per 5 lbs of weight (rounding up); other Attributes one dot each; one Ability of the caster's choosing at a rating equal to her permanent Essence (capped at her own rating in that Ability). An additional 5 motes grants a second Ability at the same rating; further Essence (up to 20 motes total) can add a +1 specialty or raise an Attribute by one dot. It continues its last command until the committed Essence is withdrawn or the object is destroyed.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.

name: Mast-Shattering Spell
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that hurls a ball of steel-hard Essence into an enemy ship's mast (or oars), exploding it in a lethal spray of splinters.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One ship or vessel within one mile and clearly visible (weather reduces range). For 20 motes, a spiked ball of Essence smashes the target's main mast, which explodes; everyone within 20 yards must Dodge (difficulty 1) or take 10 lethal health levels. Magically reinforced masts (e.g. Mast's Unbreakable Will Prana) may survive if the caster's reflexive Wits + Occult roll (difficulty = the reinforcer's permanent Essence) fails; First Age vessels commonly have reinforced masts, and masts of the Five Magical Materials are wholly immune. A variant targets a mastless ship's oars instead, dealing 5 lethal health levels (soaked normally) to the rowers via flying splinters.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.

name: Mists of Eventide
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that conjures a dreamless, un-refreshing sleeping mist covering a 10-yard circle, dropping most mortal creatures instantly and lasting until the following sunrise.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Creatures in the area of the spell, cast anywhere within 50 yards of the caster. For 15 motes, an opalescent mist covers a 10-yard-diameter circle; mere skin contact (inhalation unnecessary) puts victims into magical, dreamless slumber lasting until the next sunset-then-sunrise. Mortals are affected instantly; Exalts, spirits, and Wyld-shaped creatures may resist with a Stamina + Resistance roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence). Has no effect on Fair Folk, the undead, intangible spirits/ghosts, or automata. Victims who are forcibly woken early suffer a -3 penalty to all actions as if drugged, and sleepers never regain Essence from the magical sleep (needing normal rest afterward as if no time passed). The mist itself dissipates after three turns without a trace.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.

name: Paralyzing Contradiction
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that forces everyone intelligent within 50 yards to freeze and spend all their actions puzzling over an impossible philosophical koan until they individually reason their way free.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: All creatures within range. For 15 motes, anyone with Intelligence greater than 1 within 50 yards who sees the caster's fiery sigil or hears her koan (mortals, Exalts, spirits, Fair Folk, sufficiently intelligent undead; not automata; the blind-and-deaf are immune) must devote full actions to solving it. Affected characters' players make an Intelligence + Lore roll each turn (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence, successes cumulative) to break free; they cannot assist others, and rolls are full actions, not reflexive -- only automatic defenses (e.g. Flow Like Blood) still function. Held or extended actions are interrupted. Anyone attacked is immediately freed. Ends when all affected solve the koan, the spell is countered, or the caster dies, at which point everyone forgets the koan and its solution.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.

Convincing her otherwise afterward requires irrefutable evidence plus a successful Intelligence + Bureaucracy roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence).

requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.

For 30 motes, cast from dawn to noon on a clear day with the aid of an elemental of the target element (Essence 3+, who strikes the item five times at 5 motes/strike), the item permanently gains one elemental enchantment for the life of the item (until countered or re-enchanted; one enchantment per item, replaceable but not stackable by recasting): Air -- item weighs 1/5 as much (weapon Speed +1, armor fatigue/mobility -1), or on command (1 committed mote or 1 temp Willpower) becomes cool/cold (+3 dice to Endurance in heat, weapons deal +2L cold damage). Earth -- +2L/2B soak, never needs sharpening/repair-by-wear. Fire -- on command becomes warm/hot (+3 dice to Endurance in cold, weapons +2L heat damage), or becomes fire-immune (object only, not bearer). Water -- on command reshapes itself (retains mass/material, folds/resizes; damage persists through reshaping). Wood -- self-repairs at 1 health level/hour if not destroyed.

name: River of Blood
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that transmutes a flowing river or stream into rank blood for miles downstream, killing aquatic life and sickening nearby mortals who drink or linger.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One body of flowing water the caster can see across (no effect on ponds, lakes, or oceans). For 15+ motes, the water becomes blood for a number of miles downstream equal to the caster's permanent Essence (extendable at 3 motes/additional mile). Aquatic creatures without another water source die; plants within a mile sicken and die over days; nearby beasts flee; the blood nourishes nothing living except blood-drinking creatures, and it attracts hungry ghosts and the walking dead. Mortals/mortal beasts remaining within a mile must make a daily Stamina + Endurance roll (difficulty 2) or fall incurably ill, suffering a -1 penalty for the rest of the spell's duration. The river reverts to normal water after a number of days equal to the caster's Willpower, though it does not cure or revive anything harmed while it was blood.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.

The caster gains +1 die to Manipulation rolls with audiences who can hear the mystical voice, but the obviously magical nature of the speech marks him as a powerful being, provoking strong reactions (respect, awe, fear, or loathing) and making casual interaction difficult; frequent use draws attention and rumor.

name: Shadow Summons

requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One living creature, requiring an arcane link to the victim (obtained beforehand or forged as part of the ritual). For 15 motes, a midnight-to-moonset ritual (pentagram, boiled pitch, 55 repetitions of the target's name) tears the victim's shadow free to arrive at the caster's side before sunrise, where it is bound in the pentagram until sunrise. The caster may then either use the shadow as a messenger (it returns to the victim, who alone hears the message clearly) or destroy it in a burst of eldritch light, which causes the victim one turn of total incapacitation and a wound-penalty equal to the caster's permanent Essence for a full week; a destroyed shadow takes a full lunar month to regrow.

name: Silent Words of Dreams and Nightmares
summary: Terrestrial Circle ritual that sends a crafted dream or nightmare to a distant target via an arcane link, subtly nudging her waking judgment or draining her Willpower with repeated night terrors.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature anywhere in Creation, requiring an arcane link (blood/skin sample, or a memory-crafted portrait) and a 10-minute ritual with silvered mirrors and lotus incense. For 10 motes, if the target is asleep her image appears in the mirrors and the vision enters her mind (otherwise it waits until she sleeps). The caster's Willpower + Occult roll: if advising against the victim's own inclination, difficulty = her most relevant Virtue, and success makes her regard the advised action as wisest; if reinforcing a course she already favors, successes add bonus dice to one matching Virtue check. Alternatively, the caster can send nonspecific night terrors: the victim's player rolls Willpower on waking (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence); failure costs temporary Willpower equal to the caster's permanent Essence (regained normally), and repeated nightly nightmares add a cumulative one-die penalty to the morning Conviction roll, risking total Willpower drain and a permanent derangement. Targets normally believe the visions are natural unless a Perception + Occult roll (difficulty 4) reveals otherwise; many Hearthstones/artifacts that protect against nightmares are effective against this spell.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.

name: Sleep of Stony Safety

requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster and optional allies (up to the caster's permanent Willpower). For 15+ motes (base covers the caster; +5 motes per additional sleeper), only castable at night, a one-minute ritual with sand encases participants in a white sandstone dome: soak 15L/15B, 30 health levels to destroy, ignores hits under 5 health levels, and grants total cover including against magic that normally ignores cover. Sleepers are unaware of their surroundings but wake to a soft chime if the dome is attacked, letting the caster choose to end the spell early or wait it out; at dawn (or when ended) the dome crumbles harmlessly to sand and sleepers rise freely. Provides comfortable rest (even in armor) but does not guarantee sleep for those with insomnia; it does spare sleepers the need to wake for mundane bodily needs.

name: Sorcerer's Irresistible Puppetry
summary: Terrestrial Circle two-part spell: a ritual that prepares a helpless or willing creature for later possession, then a separate activation that lets the caster seize and operate the target's body for up to 24 hours.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature, unconscious/immobilized (or willing) for the preparation ritual. Ritual (25 motes, one hour): binds the target with sigil papers and incense, channeling the caster's Essence into a jewel that becomes a permanent possession focus. Activation (20 motes committed, up to 24 hours): the caster's Willpower + Occult roll (difficulty = target's Willpower + permanent Essence) over three turns to win a hidden contest of wills (the victim only feels a headache); on success the caster possesses and operates the body, using the higher of his or the creature's Abilities, the creature's Physical/Perception/Appearance Attributes plus his own Mental/Social Attributes, and his own remaining Essence for his own spells/Charms (not the creature's magic). Damage to the possessed body transfers to the caster as bashing damage; if the host dies while possessed, the jewel shatters, the spell breaks, and the caster loses 3 temporary Willpower plus takes bashing damage. On a failed possession attempt, the Essence is spent and locked for a day, and the caster loses 1 temporary Willpower, but may retry in 24 hours. Only affects living creatures with an Essence rating (no effect on undead, automata, plants, or dematerialized spirits); high-Essence targets are harder to possess.
