name: Theft of Memory
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that plucks a single specific memory from a victim's mind by touch and crystallizes it into an emerald, which only the original owner can safely reclaim.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature the caster can touch. For 15 motes, the caster must hold a flawless thumbnail-sized emerald (Resources ••) and know which memory she wants; her Charisma + Occult roll (difficulty = target's Willpower) succeeding steals the specific incident-memory (not Charms/spells/other Traits) into the gem, leaving the victim with no other way to recall it. Anyone else who swallows the gem just suffers a mundane emerald's ill effects; only the original owner can relive the memory by clasping the gem to her forehead and concentrating for a turn (taking as long as the memory itself, during which she can do nothing else). The Essence display can be reflexively hidden with Dexterity + Larceny (opposed by a Perception + Occult roll at that difficulty, or the caster's permanent Essence if unrolled). Failure or a countered casting costs the caster a two-die penalty to Mental Attribute rolls for the scene and prevents stealing from that victim again this scene; cannot be cast in combat despite its instant effect.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 122 (PDF 123).

name: Thunder Wolf's Howl
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that unleashes a legendary, unnatural howl over a 20-yard area, dealing unsoakable-by-armor bashing damage and then stunning survivors with deafness and disorientation.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: An area 20 yards across, within 100 yards of the caster. For 10 motes, the caster's Intelligence + Occult roll becomes levels of bashing damage to all creatures and non-magical objects in the area; this damage ignores armor and cannot be parried/dodged (only soak and soak-boosting Charms apply; undead and inanimate objects halve their soak). Survivors then suffer a -2 die penalty to all dice pools from stunning for a number of turns equal to the roll's successes; Exalted and magical creatures may make a reflexive Stamina + Resistance roll to reduce (not eliminate below zero) that duration.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 122 (PDF 123).

name: The Tree's Many Branches
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that grows the caster extra pairs of fully functional bark-covered arms for a scene, improving initiative and multi-action penalties and adding extra health levels.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 5 motes per pair, the caster grows that many pairs of extra arms (sharing the rest of her body's Physical Attributes), up to a maximum pairs equal to her permanent Essence. Each pair grants +1 Initiative and reduces multiple-action dice-pool penalties by two (not below zero), plus one additional -0 health level (lost first to wounds, and not healable; losing these health levels does not remove the arms). At the end of the scene, or if the caster is slain, the extra arms turn to dead wood and fall off.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 122-123 (PDF 123-124).

name: Unbreakable Bones of Stone
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that petrifies the caster's own bones, granting bonus Strength and Stamina, halved wound penalties, and reduced fall damage until the following sunrise.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 20 motes, until the sun next crosses the sky the caster adds her permanent Essence to both Strength and Stamina (the Stamina bonus raises soak as normal), halves (rounded down) all wound penalties, and halves (rounded up) fall damage. Her eyes turn granite-colored, skin turns cold and ashen, and body weight increases by 50%.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed p. 123 (PDF 124).

name: Unconquerable Self
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell of last resort: for a single mote, instantly incinerates the caster and all possessions in contact with her in an unstoppable, final, ghost-leaving-none death.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 1 mote and only a preparatory turn of concentration (no gestures or incantation needed, making it a surprise even to learned foes), the caster's anima erupts and consumes her and everything in contact with her (leaving only fine white ash), except for items not possessed by her but merely touching her (e.g. binding ropes). This death is final and leaves no ghost; a Celestial Exalted who dies this way simply reincarnates as usual in a new body with none of the sorcerer's original personality. Onlookers may be briefly blinded by the flash but are otherwise unharmed.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 123-124 (PDF 124-125).

name: Unstoppable Fountain of the Depths
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that erupts a crushing 10-foot-wide wall of water in front of the caster for ten minutes, then leaves behind a lasting, unpoisonable drinking-water stream.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Area of effect. For 20 motes, a fountain (10 ft wide, 5 ft high) bursts from the ground and sweeps outward; the caster's Perception + Occult roll (plus automatic successes equal to permanent Essence) is the attack, base damage 10B plus successes, unparryable without Charms (dodge only). Anyone taking enough damage to risk knockdown rolls Stamina + Resistance (difficulty 5); standing back up while still in the torrent requires a Strength + Athletics roll (difficulty = caster's Occult, +2 automatic successes with a handhold), and every additional turn spent in the flow deals 3 automatic bashing levels (soaked normally). The crushing torrent lasts 10 minutes unless countered, after which it becomes a gentle, pure, unpoisonable/unsaltable drinking stream lasting a number of days equal to the caster's permanent Essence.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 123-124 (PDF 124-125).

name: Viridian Mantle of Underwater Journeys
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that wraps the caster and nearby unarmored allies in living seaweed, letting the group breathe and swim freely underwater at their normal running speed for as long as they stay submerged.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster and optional unarmored allies (up to the caster's permanent Essence, staying within 3 yards of each other and in contact with the target water at casting). For 20 motes, seaweed fronds cover each target as a second skin, letting them breathe underwater and swim/walk at their normal running rate; the fronds also add +1L/2B soak (not counted as armor, so it stacks with armor-excluding Charms). Lasts as long as the targets remain submerged; one turn after fully surfacing, the seaweed flakes off, leaving them wet but unharmed.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 123-124 (PDF 124-125).

name: Virtuous Guardian of Flame
summary: Terrestrial Circle spell that binds a Willpower-committed guardian flame to a target, which autonomously shields them from ranged attacks and parries melee blows as a great fiery sword until the next sunrise.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature. For 25 motes (committed), lasts until the next sunrise or until the target dispels it. Normally a torch-sized flame (can hide in a lantern/torch within 3 yards of the caster; spotting it requires Intelligence + Occult, difficulty 5), it expands to man-sized the instant the target is physically threatened. Against ranged attacks it forms a shield giving 75% cover (-3 successes on ranged attacks against the target) and incinerates blocked mundane missiles. Against melee it becomes a fiery sword that parries automatically using the target's Occult + Essence (no initiative cost, cannot itself attack), dealing 4 lethal health levels (soaked normally) to any barehanded attacker it parries; it can parry a number of incoming attacks per turn equal to the caster's permanent Essence. The protected target may still act and split dice pools normally. The guardian is not intelligent, can be fooled by stunts, and if faced with simultaneous ranged and melee attacks in one turn, the caster must choose which it defends against (it cannot do both).
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Terrestrial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Emerald, printed pp. 124-125 (PDF 125-126). This is the last spell of the Circle of Emerald (Terrestrial Circle); the Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) begins immediately after on the same PDF page (125/printed 124), per Savant and Sorcerer's own section header.

name: The Battle's End
summary: Celestial Circle spell that binds an entire visible battlefield in a compulsion to lay down arms and stand still, breaking only if a bound combatant successfully wills herself to violence.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One battlefield up to 100 yards in diameter, no more than 50 yards away, that the caster (who cannot be a combatant) has full view of. For 30 motes, a purple wheel of light bearing the rune of the Maiden of Endings compels everyone in the area to stand down for a number of turns equal to twice the caster's permanent Essence. Exalts and God-Blooded may attempt a Willpower roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence) to act violently anyway; success lets them attack next turn but breaks the geas for everyone. The caster is bound by his own spell even from outside its area -- if he or an ally raises arms against anyone under the compulsion, that character's player must make the same Willpower roll, and success breaks the spell; if the caster himself breaks it this way, he loses 3 temporary Willpower for abusing the sign of Saturn.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire (the book's term for Celestial Circle sorcery), printed pp. 125-126 (PDF 126-127). A First Age variant of this spell was reportedly used to sanctify duel sites against interference, mentioned in the source but not a separately inventoried mechanic.

name: Between the Minute and the Hour
summary: Celestial Circle spell that opens a scrying window onto a chosen past moment at the caster's current location, replaying and letting her rewind events up to centuries old.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One moment in history, at the caster's own location. For 20 motes, the caster may view any event up to 100 years in the past per point of her Occult Ability (limited to before the Wyld took hold of the area, if applicable); the replay runs for a number of minutes equal to her Willpower, and she may rewind and re-watch it repeatedly while concentrating, up to the end of the scene. She cannot revisit an event she has already viewed with this spell, may take no other actions while concentrating, and must make a reflexive Stamina + Resistance roll (difficulty = health levels taken) to maintain concentration if damaged.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed p. 125 (PDF 126).

name: Bone Lion
summary: Celestial Circle ritual, requiring a human sacrifice, that raises an undying skeletal lion to hunt a single target relentlessly across all of Creation for 101 days, reviving each dusk if not fully destroyed.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature. For 30 motes and the ritual sacrifice of a living human (blinded, eviscerated, bled into a pit, with two Resources-•• diamond eyes cast into the blood), a skeletal lion rises and tracks the target by a sorcerous bond to within several hundred yards, then uses mundane tracking skill to close in. Stat block: Strength 12, Dexterity 6, Stamina 10, Wits 6; Athletics 4, Awareness 5 (Spot Victim +3), Brawl 4, Dodge 4, Presence 5 (Intimidation +3), Survival 5 (Track +3); Bite Speed 12 Accuracy 11 Damage 14L Defense 8, Claw Speed 12 Accuracy 11 Damage 16L Defense 9; Soak 10L/15B (bony exterior 5L/5B); Willpower 10; Essence 1; it never tires, needs no air/food/water, and can swim indefinitely. If it kills its prey it buries the body in a bone cairn and the spell ends; if defeated, every piece (including the diamond eyes) must be destroyed by sorcery, Charms, or fire, or it regenerates at the next sunset at that spot and resumes the hunt, for up to 101 days total, after which any surviving target is safe and the lion turns to dust.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 125-126 (PDF 126-127), including the Bone Lion stat block spanning the PDF 126/127 page break. Marked unreviewed pending a visual (rendered-page) check of the stat block per this project's OCR/extraction verification rule; the prose portion was read from the PDF's own selectable text layer.

name: Cantata of Empty Voices
summary: Celestial Circle spell that surrounds the caster with singing spectral choir-visages whose sound inflicts ongoing ear-bleeding damage and a crippling distraction penalty over a huge radius.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: All creatures within area (range 800 yards per point of the caster's permanent Essence). For 30 motes, every hearing creature in range takes 2L (soaked only by Stamina/Stamina-boosting Charms) at the start of each turn and suffers a -2 die penalty to all actions from the distraction, unless deaf or with ears fully plugged; Exalts/God-Blooded may make one Stamina + Resistance roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence) to ignore the penalty (not the damage). Lasts a number of turns equal to twice the caster's permanent Essence, until countered, or until the caster is knocked unconscious; the caster is immune and can act normally, and the surrounding illusory visages provide no cover or defense.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed p. 126 (PDF 127).

name: Cloud Trapeze
summary: Celestial Circle spell that envelops the caster and a large cargo in a steerable, weather-proof flying cloud that can hide among ordinary clouds from mundane and even some supernatural trackers.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster (plus up to 500 lbs of people/cargo per point of permanent Essence). For 25 motes, the cloud carries its contents at up to 100 mph in a chosen direction for as long as the caster concentrates (no time limit); the caster cannot cast spells or use Charms while maintaining it but may converse/act simply. To hide among real clouds, the caster's Wits + Occult roll (plus automatic successes equal to permanent Essence) sets the difficulty for spotting the trapeze or supernaturally tracking it; no mundane tracking method can follow it while hidden. The trapeze protects contents from weather and conceals them from sight but offers no real protection from attack (treated as an unseen target).
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 126-127 (PDF 127-128).

name: Eternal Crystalline Encasement
summary: Celestial Circle ritual that seals a statue-sized creature or object in a nearly indestructible timeless crystal shell, halting decay and aging entirely until the shell is broken.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature or object up to statue-and-base size (~27 cubic feet). For 20 motes and a dawn-to-dusk ritual (must begin at dawn on a clear day), the target is sealed in a gold-tinged, inch-thick crystalline coating for as long as the encasement survives. Inanimate contents never corrode or weaken; living contents never wither, age, or decay, and experience the entire imprisonment as instantaneous; living targets must be unconscious before casting, since any movement disrupts the weaving. The shell auto-soaks the first 50 health levels of any single attack (non-magical damage is soaked entirely; magical damage such as sorcerous fire or Five-Magical-Materials weapons can matter), and any attack exceeding 50 health levels shatters it outright. A matching crystalline wand created at the ritual's end can also shatter the encasement (and itself) on touch; Sapphire Countermagic also destroys it.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed p. 127 (PDF 128).

name: The Faithful Ally
summary: Celestial Circle two-part spell: a tattooing ritual that bonds the caster to an ally, then a later activation letting either instantly summon the other to their side from anywhere in Creation.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster and one creature; creates an arcane link if the extra 5 motes are paid. Ritual (20 motes, ~8 hours): matching sapphire-ink tattoos are placed on caster and ally (Perception + Linguistics roll, difficulty 4, to match exactly); the tattoo can optionally become an arcane link for 5 more motes. Activation: either party touches two fingers to the tattoo and concentrates for a turn to open communication; if within that turn either calls for aid, the caster may spend 20 motes to transport himself or the ally to the other's side (arriving within 20 yards, timing set by initiative). The bond cannot cross into the Underworld, Wyld, or Malfeas, and teleportation wards block it; using the tattoo is an enchantment activation, not spell-casting, and can be done as an abort or folded into a stunt/multiple action. Using the enchantment consumes both tattoos; a caster may have a number of active Faithful Ally tattoos equal to his permanent Essence.
cost: 20 motes to cast, 20 motes to activate
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 127-128 (PDF 128-129).

name: Force of Life's Summer
summary: Celestial Circle spell that instantly grows one non-sentient plant or animal to full late-summer adult maturity, taming any animal targeted as if hand-raised.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One living, non-sentient organism (cannot target any sentient creature, since the education/experience of growth can't be mimicked). For 25 motes, the organism grows one year of life per turn until reaching (but never surpassing) full adult maturity, appearing as it would in the late summer of its life cycle -- crops become harvestable, flowers bloom, trees bear fruit. Animals targeted become tame and friendly toward the caster, obeying simple commands as if raised from birth by her.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed p. 128 (PDF 129).

name: Geyser of Corruption
summary: Celestial Circle spell that hurls a ball of amber acid to burst into a 20-yard-diameter corrosive cloud, dealing ongoing aggravated damage that ignores substantial soak until washed away with clean water.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Area of effect, up to 50 yards away. For 30 motes, the caster's Dexterity + Occult or Dexterity + Thrown roll (whichever is higher) is the attack; creatures in the 20-yard blast may dodge but only Charms allow a parry. The acid ignores 5 points of soak and deals 8 dice of aggravated damage per turn to inanimate objects/armor, or 3A per turn (also ignoring 5 soak) to living targets, continuing until washed away with enough clean water to bathe the whole affected object/area.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 128-129 (PDF 129-130).

name: Hideous Confusion of Tongues
summary: Celestial Circle spell that curses everyone within 100 yards to speak only gibberish for hours, with the curse spreading contagiously to anyone the afflicted talk to.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: All creatures in range (100-yard radius from the caster). For 35 motes, every creature touched by the expanding wave of turquoise Essence is cursed to speak only glossolalia (meaningless known-word gibberish) for a number of hours equal to twice the caster's permanent Essence; the curse spreads to anyone an afflicted victim speaks to afterward, and can reinfect a cured victim who talks to someone still afflicted. Occult-using characters may make a Perception + Occult roll at casting, or a reflexive Perception + Awareness roll (difficulty 3) afterward, to realize what happened; a reflexive Intelligence + Occult roll (difficulty 3) can identify the specific spell. Sapphire Countermagic cures an individual (or the whole spell if used at the moment of casting, in which case that victim becomes immune to reinfection). Has no effect on the caster or on any creature with permanent Essence greater than the caster's, and only impairs speech, not sorcery or Charms.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 128-129 (PDF 129-130).

name: Imbue Amalgam
summary: Celestial Circle day-long ritual that permanently transmutes a mortal into a magically empowered, unswervingly loyal 'amalgam' with purchased Attributes, Abilities, Essence, Charms, soak and attacks.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One mortal creature with permanent Essence lower than the caster's; creates an arcane link (Exalts and other Essence-users are immune). For 15+ motes and a full day using a bespoke jeweled statue (Resources ••••) matching the desired transformations, the target permanently gains the statue's physical traits while becoming servile to the caster (a Willpower roll is needed for her to interpret orders beyond their literal sense). Point costs: +1 Attribute dot 2 motes, +1 Ability dot 1 mote, +1 Essence dot 4 motes (or +5 temporary Essence for 4 motes, usable only for granted Charms), +1 permanent Willpower 4 motes, +1L/+1B soak 1 mote each, a learned Charm 3 motes (of the caster's own Exalt-type only), and various hand-to-hand/ranged weapon upgrades (Speed/Accuracy/Defense/Rate/damage/range/bashing-to-lethal) at 1 mote each. Caps: cannot raise the amalgam's Essence above (caster's permanent Essence - 1); cannot add more Attribute/Ability dots than the caster's Occult + Essence; cannot spend more motes on a weapon than Occult + Essence; sorcery granted cannot exceed Terrestrial Circle. Amalgams bleed, heal, and resist sorcery/disease as Exalted, can stunt, and are visibly magical constructs (never passable as ordinary mortals, at best as Wyld-twisted mutants); a new statue cannot be made for the same target until the prior one is fully used.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 128-130 (PDF 129-131), including the boxed per-trait cost table (PDF p. 130). Marked unreviewed pending a visual (rendered-page) check of the cost table per this project's OCR/extraction verification rule; the prose portion was read from the PDF's own selectable text layer.

name: Insidious Tendrils of Hate
summary: Celestial Circle ritual that makes multiple linked targets paranoid and hateful, interpreting everything said to them in the worst possible light, turning friends into enemies over days.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: A number of beings equal to the caster's Manipulation + permanent Essence, each requiring an arcane link and all within 30 yards of each other at casting. For 20 motes and a short ritual burning a dozen exotic snakeskins (Resources •• total), each target's player may make a reflexive Willpower roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence) to resist; failure means the target believes everyone lies to her and is surrounded by enemies, interpreting all statements in the worst possible way (Essence-users get a reflexive Willpower roll, difficulty 1, to avoid misinterpreting any single statement). A remarkable success (4+ successes) on the initial resistance roll lets a target realize she was targeted by a spell. Lasts a number of days equal to the caster's Manipulation, until countered, or until the caster is slain.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 129-130 (PDF 130-131).

name: Ivory Orchid Pavilion
summary: Celestial Circle spell that grows a lavish, self-refilling ivory mansion from the ground for entertaining any dignitary, standing 24 hours before crumbling into orchid petals.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One conjured building. For 20 motes, an ornate ivory pavilion grows and splits open, housing/entertaining 100 people per point of the caster's permanent Essence, furnished with self-refilling food and wine fine enough to host any Celestial divinity or Exalted without embarrassment. Lasts 24 hours before crumbling to orchid petals (white orchids grow on the site for five years afterward). Fragile: 10 health levels, soak 5, highly flammable (takes several minutes to fully burn); destroyed instantly by Sapphire Countermagic.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 130-131 (PDF 131-132).

name: Magma Kraken
summary: Celestial Circle spell that erupts ten molten-rock tentacles from the ground across a 50-yard radius, which the caster can partly direct to grapple foes while the rest smash indiscriminately.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Area of effect within 500 yards (tentacles erupt in a 50-yard radius, chosen by the caster). For 35 motes, ten 15-yard tentacles (Strength 10, Dexterity = caster's permanent Essence, Brawl = caster's Occult, acting on the caster's initiative; base damage 5L + Strength 10 + caster's permanent Essence, successes add normally, 10s count double; fire damage; no Mental/Social/Stamina; ignore bashing damage and soak the first 10 levels of lethal per attack; 10 health levels, regenerating each turn end, needing 10+ unsoaked levels in one turn to destroy) erupt, forcing a Dexterity + Athletics roll (difficulty 2) to avoid knockdown near an eruption point. Lasts one scene unless destroyed/countered, then the tentacles harden into obsidian sculptures. The caster may take control of tentacles one at a time each turn (full concentration, equivalent to a simple-type Charm; cannot activate non-reflexive Charms, split dice pools, or cast spells while doing so) up to a number equal to her Perception, using them for clinch/grapple maneuvers at full dice pools while uncontrolled tentacles mindlessly attack the nearest foe; broken concentration releases all controlled clinches.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed p. 131 (PDF 132).

name: Mercury's Deliverance
summary: Celestial Circle ritual that raises a one-day dome-shaped barrier immune to Emerald and Sapphire sorcery, blocking all teleportation, scrying, and enchanted-item entry across its boundary.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Area of effect, up to 100 yards in diameter per point of the caster's permanent Essence. For 30 motes, after inscribing a boundary circle with five Mercury hexagrams and a central circle, the caster activates the ward from the center; it lasts from casting until the next sunrise. Sorcery may be cast freely inside the barrier but cannot cross outward, and the barrier blocks all teleportation, scrying, other long-range effects, and the entry of sorcery-enchanted items from outside. It flares visibly whenever an outside spell tries to cross it. The barrier cannot be countered from outside by anything weaker than Adamant Countermagic, though Sapphire Countermagic cast at the central mark can dispel it from within.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 131-132 (PDF 132-133).

name: Outside Worlds Within
summary: Celestial Circle ritual that transforms one sealed room into a full sensory replica of any environment in Creation the caster has visited or holds an organic sample of, lasting a month at a time.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One room, up to a 50-yard radius per point of the caster's permanent Essence (including vertically). For 25 motes, requires either firsthand memory of the target environment or an organic sample (a blade of grass, a petal, a hair) from it, plus a fully sealed, physically and spiritually cleansed chamber (no outside light/air/dust) and a special candle (Resources ••). Once sealed, the room's light, air, floor, and weather transform to match the memory or, if using a sample, the season/weather at the sample's place of origin on the day of casting. Lasts one month before reverting over three days unless renewed (re-entering and spending 25 motes again). The candle and any sample are consumed.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 131-133 (PDF 132-134).

name: The Princes of the Fallen Tower
summary: Celestial Circle spell that conjures shambling rust-golem automatons able to corrode metal, erode stone, rot wood, and dissolve cloth on touch, ideal for demolishing structures rather than fighting.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Conjured creatures. For 30 motes, summons a number of man-sized rust-golem 'princes' equal to the caster's permanent Essence, each of whose touch ignores the first 6 points of an object's soak and deals 8L, continuing to eat away at the object for 25 turns per touch; enchanted items and the Five Magical Materials are immune, as are living organisms. Stat block: Strength 5, Dexterity 2, Stamina 5; Craft 3 (Demolition +2); Claw Speed 4 Accuracy 4 Damage 9L Defense 2; Soak 8L/10B (ferric body 6L/5B); Essence 2. Princes have no combat aptitude and little use in a fight, but excel at wrecking fortifications or towns; they last about five hours unless countered/destroyed, and an unsupervised prince may destroy anything nearby, including the caster's own Manse.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 132-133 (PDF 133-134), including the Prince of the Fallen Tower stat block. Marked unreviewed pending a visual (rendered-page) check of the stat block per this project's OCR/extraction verification rule; the prose portion was read from the PDF's own selectable text layer.

name: Rolling Earth Carpet
summary: Celestial Circle spell that smooths and hardens the ground into perfect, trackless road conditions in a 20-yard bubble that travels with the caster, negating weather and small obstacles.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 20 motes (committed for the spell's duration), a 20-yard-radius bubble of flattened, weathered-stone-like ground travels with the caster, fitting up to ~100 marching humans or ~50 mounted riders; the ground reverts to its original state (including any snow/puddles) as the bubble passes. Negates weather penalties within the bubble (feels like a warm spring day; no precipitation; snow/water evaporate) and clears small obstacles (sand, mud, fallen rocks, marsh, low walls/fences), though buildings, high walls, boulders, trees, and large creatures must still be gone around, and steep terrain still slows travel. Mortal trackers cannot follow its passage; supernatural trackers suffer a +3 difficulty. Lasts as long as the caster maintains the committed Essence, ending if she is killed.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 132-133 (PDF 133-134).

name: Servant of Infallible Location
summary: Celestial Circle spell that conjures a small blue-flame sparrow automaton that dances out directions to any known item, person, place, or nearby simple necessity, staying tethered near the caster.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One conjured creature; uses an arcane link to the sought object/person if not simply nearby/named. For 15 motes, summons a mute sparrow of blue flame that communicates only through directional 'dances,' indicating whether the target is far, close, or very close (growing more excited near the goal) and whether it's moving; it can find anything the caster has previously encountered or has an arcane link to, or simple nearby necessities within 500 yards (water, food, an exit). Stat block: Dexterity 5, Perception 5; Awareness 5, Dodge 5, Lore 3 (Landmarks +2), Performance 4 (Dance +2), Survival 3; Dive Attack Speed 8 Accuracy 6 Damage 1L Defense 0; Soak 1L/2B; Willpower 5; Essence 1. It never strays more than a few yards from the caster and moves only as fast as she can travel; lasts until its goal is reached, it is dismissed, or it or the caster is slain.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 133-134 (PDF 134-135), including the sparrow's stat block. Marked unreviewed pending a visual (rendered-page) check of the stat block per this project's OCR/extraction verification rule; the prose portion was read from the PDF's own selectable text layer.

name: Shadow Theft
summary: Celestial Circle ritual that rips a target's shadow free and seals it in a crystal globe, drawing the victim toward the caster over time and letting the caster spy through her eyes.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature; requires a specially enchanted portrait (Resources ••) and an orichalcum-caged crystal globe (Resources ••). For 30 motes, the target's shadow is sealed in the globe until the caster releases it, Sapphire Countermagic is cast on the globe, or both the globe and portrait are destroyed. The victim feels an ever-growing compulsion to reunite with her shadow (and the caster who holds it); after a year, she mindlessly wanders toward it with no sense of distance or danger. The caster may spend 5 motes and a turn of concentration to see through the victim's eyes for five turns; an Essence-using victim may make a reflexive Willpower roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence) to subconsciously block this, and a remarkable success (3+) lets her know she was watched. Sorcerers often ransom shadows back for tasks or rare artifacts.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 133-134 (PDF 134-135).

name: Shadows of the Ancient Past
summary: Celestial Circle spell that projects a silent, untouchable visual illusion recreating a place or object as it looked in the past, with peopled scenes and an optional focused demonstration of a specific object's use.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Area of effect, radius 20 yards per point of the caster's permanent Essence. For 25+ motes, a ghostly silver-and-white illusion of the area's past appears (ruins whole, rooms furnished, decayed books restored, illusory people moving through their business) with no sound, smell, or touch, and cannot be interacted with (attempts pass right through). Lasts as long as the caster concentrates. For an extra 5 motes, she can focus on one object at a time: if stationary, she levitates over to examine it; if small/portable, an illusory person appears to pick it up and demonstrate its use (e.g. performing katas with an ancient weapon, or reading from a book).
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed p. 134 (PDF 135).

name: The Spawning of Monsters
summary: Celestial Circle ritual that magically cross-breeds two different creatures, storing one's peripheral Essence in an acorn to force mating and gestate a hybrid monster loyal to the caster, subject to Storyteller approval.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: see text. For 30 motes, the caster drains a male creature's entire peripheral Essence pool into an acorn (usable within a month), then feeds the acorn to a male of a species able to mate with the intended mother, forcing it into season; mating drains the ruddy Essence into the female, who gestates the hybrid in 1/10 normal time (often just weeks). The birth kills any mortal host; an Essence-using host may survive with a Stamina + Resistance roll (difficulty = the new creature's permanent Essence; difficulty 1 if a female sorcerer hosts herself). The offspring inherits the higher of each parent's Attributes, Virtues, Willpower, permanent Essence, and shared Abilities, plus any Ability only one parent had, any Essence-using nature, and either parent's Charms/mystical abilities (but no Backgrounds/equipment); it matures in one week and is wholly devoted to the caster. Countermagic can stop the ritual before conception but not after; the final creature's appearance and stats require Storyteller approval.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 134-135 (PDF 135-136).

name: Summon the Army of the Wild
summary: Celestial Circle spell that calls every ordinary bird, reptile, and mammal for miles around to fight alongside the caster in battle, with effectiveness entirely dependent on what creatures happen to be nearby.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Summoned creatures within range. For 30 motes, all mortal birds, reptiles, and mammals with Intelligence under 2 (including others' trained/loyal animals, even an enemy's) within a number of miles equal to the caster's permanent Essence are compelled to her side, arriving over about two minutes starting the turn after casting (no effect on magical creatures, Wyld-twisted beasts, sentient beings, familiars, invertebrates, fish, amphibians, or mobile plants). The caster must personally join the fight (cannot command from afar); the animals never fail Valor checks, never harm each other, and fight to the death unless released, until the enemy or caster is slain or the sun next crosses the horizon. She may issue general commands (advance, retreat, flank, etc.) but grants no extra Attributes/Abilities -- an army's usefulness depends entirely on what species happen to be summoned.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 134-136 (PDF 135-137).

name: Summoning the Heart of Darkness
summary: Celestial Circle spell that shrouds a one-mile radius around the caster in a towering column of total darkness and muffled, disorienting sound for a full day.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Area of effect, one-mile radius around the caster, reaching 10 miles into the sky. For 30 motes, all normal vision is impaired throughout the area and sounds echo indistinctly (even nearby shouts seem distant); anyone hearing the reverberating cries of others trapped inside must make a Valor roll (difficulty 3) to keep their composure. Creatures with supernaturally enhanced senses or supernatural tracking suffer a -2 die penalty to moving actions inside the darkness; others suffer a difficulty increase equal to the caster's permanent Essence on all actions relying on unaffected senses. The caster is not immune to the sensory effects (most prepare an escape method in advance) but the darkness lasts 24 hours regardless of whether the caster is slain, ending only if countered.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 135-136 (PDF 136-137).

name: Swift Spirit of Winged Transportation
summary: Celestial Circle spell that summons a massive winged air spirit able to lift and fly an entire ship (or comparable vessel/building) up to 200 mph anywhere the caster commands.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One summoned spirit, which is forced to pay the Essence cost of its own manifestation. For 25 motes, the caster (aboard the vessel, or within a number of yards equal to her permanent Essence) summons a 500-ft by 200-ft winged air spirit that lifts and carries up to 1,000 tons (a vessel up to 300 x 120 feet, e.g. carrying 400 people and cargo) over a mile into the air at up to 200 mph, sheltering the deck from wind/weather. Stat block: Strength 55, Dexterity 5, Stamina 20; Athletics 10 (Feats of Strength +35), Endurance 10, Resistance 5; Crushing Grasp (Clinch) Speed 7 Accuracy 10 Damage 57B Defense 0; Soak 10L/20B; Willpower 7; Essence 3, Essence pool 71; Cost to Materialize 27. Only a flat-bottomed vessel (or one with landing supports) can be safely set down on land; the spirit can also be ordered to drop a vessel/object from height as a weapon. It remains until the destination is reached, it is ordered to land, or it is destroyed, and may not use its own Hurry Home Charm while bound to the summons.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 136-137 (PDF 137-138), including the air spirit's stat block. Marked unreviewed pending a visual (rendered-page) check of the stat block per this project's OCR/extraction verification rule; the prose portion was read from the PDF's own selectable text layer.

name: Threefold Binding of the Heart
summary: Celestial Circle spell that magically enslaves a victim's heart into genuine, intelligent devotion to the caster, with only one chance per year for the victim to break free on the anniversary of her birth.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One creature (no effect on any creature with permanent Essence greater than the caster's). For 30 motes, ropes of light pierce and merge with the victim's Essence; mortals are affected instantly, while an Essence-using victim's player may make a reflexive Willpower roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence) to resist, and success makes that Essence-wielder immune to this spell from the same caster again. Rather than a mindless drone, the victim retains intelligence and asks clarifying questions but genuinely, sincerely loves and trusts the caster, rationalizing her devotion as real (often unaware she is enchanted, especially if bound while asleep); onlookers may recognize her as an ensorcelled puppet. Once a year, on her birthday, the victim's player may make a reflexive Willpower roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence) to break free permanently (and become immune to this spell from the same caster); failure resets the bond for another year with no memory of the attempt. Bound victims will cheerfully sacrifice themselves or loved ones if they believe it serves the caster's interests.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed p. 137 (PDF 138).

name: Torrential Cascade
summary: Celestial Circle spell that raises a 20-yard-high wave from a large body of water and sends it inland to crush foes and flatten buildings, leaving lasting flood damage behind.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: One body of water at least 50 yards long/wide, within 100 yards of the caster. For 30 motes over three turns: turn 1 the target water churns audibly/visibly (detectable up to 5 miles away with Perception + Awareness); turn 2 a 20-yard-high, 100-yard-long wall of water rises; turn 3 the cascade surges inland at 300 yards/turn for a number of turns equal to the caster's permanent Essence, remaining 20 yards high and 10 yards thick. It deals 45 bashing levels/turn to fortifications and immobile structures (destroying anything one story or smaller), has a Strength + Athletics of 35 for uprooting boulders/trees, ruins crops/gardens, and deals 15 dice bashing damage/turn to creatures and small objects swept up (Exalts/Essence-users can escape with a Dexterity + Athletics roll, difficulty = caster's permanent Essence). Afterward the water recedes to roughly its original level, leaving the devastated region flooded (dry ground becomes knee-deep mud; fields become ankle-deep marsh).
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 137-138 (PDF 138-139).

name: Unity of Dreams
summary: Celestial Circle ritual invoking Venus that binds the dreams of the caster and her allies together, letting them communicate and act together with a bonus, at the cost of the bond if used to instantly regroup.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster and allies. For 20+ motes (10 motes per participant, per night), a ritual of shared nightly meditation lasting a number of nights equal to the number of participants forges a link lasting a number of months equal to the caster's permanent Essence, unless countered with Sapphire or Adamant Countermagic. Once bound, any two or more participants who are asleep at the same time share and can communicate through their (fluid, subconscious-revealing) dreams, and gain +1 die to all actions when working or fighting together while awake. Any awake-and-dreaming participant may ask the others to join her; if all agree on a destination, their sleeping bodies are physically transported there, waking on the next turn -- but invoking this transport ends the spell's other benefits (shared dreams, action bonus) entirely.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 137-138 (PDF 138-139).

name: Voices of Distant Regard
summary: Celestial Circle spell letting the caster overhear, until she next sleeps, any conversation anywhere in which the participants are discussing her, sensing rough distance and direction to each.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 25 motes, until she next sleeps the caster hears (as if present) any conversation where participants discuss her (her name need not be spoken; intent is what triggers the spell), along with a vague sense of each conversation's distance and direction, and may recognize familiar voices. To follow multiple simultaneous conversations, her player makes a Perception + Awareness roll (difficulty = number of conversations); she may instead freely ignore all but one without a roll, or block out all distant conversations to focus on a direct one. Participating in a direct conversation while also listening to a distant one requires a Perception + Awareness roll (difficulty = number of conversations + 1), and doing so may make her seem distant or simple-minded to others present.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 138-139 (PDF 139-140).

name: Wheel of the Turning Heavens
summary: Celestial Circle spell that fills the night sky over a half-mile radius with a mesmerizing illusion of spinning stars, entrancing and freezing anyone intelligent who looks up.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Creatures in the area of effect, half-mile radius centered on the caster (night-only; no effect on plants, Intelligence-1 mortals, or the caster). For 35 motes, anyone with Intelligence greater than 1 who sees the illusory swirling stars becomes entranced and unable to act for a duration of half an hour per point of the caster's permanent Essence, afterward recalling nothing. An Essence-using being's player may make a reflexive Dexterity + Awareness roll (difficulty = caster's permanent Essence) any time their view might include the sky, to recognize the illusion and avert their eyes. Ends if Sapphire or Adamant Countermagic is cast against the caster, if the caster is slain, or if any entranced creature is harmed.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 138-139 (PDF 139-140).

name: Whirlwind of Fate
summary: Celestial Circle spell that lets the caster read the strands of fate around her toward a stated goal, banking bonus dice usable one at a time to further that goal, with a penalty if the goal goes unmet.
requirements: Prerequisite Charm: Celestial Circle Sorcery.
mechanics: Target: Caster. For 20 motes, standing motionless for a turn while naming a specific goal, the caster's Intelligence + Occult roll converts each success into a bonus die (usable one at a time on any single roll furthering that goal, lasting for twice her permanent Essence in minutes). A bonus die added to a feat or stunt also grants an additional automatic success. If the stated goal is not achieved before the bonus dice expire, the caster suffers a penalty to all actions equal to however many bonus dice she actually used, lasting until the goal is met.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted who has learned Celestial Circle Sorcery. This is a generic Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) spell from Exalted: Savant and Sorcerer, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Five: Spells, Circle of Sapphire, printed pp. 138-139 (PDF 139-140). This is the last spell of the Circle of Sapphire (Celestial Circle) chronicled in Chapter Five; the Circle of Adamant (Solar Circle sorcery, beginning with Abjuration of the Maidens) follows immediately and is out of scope per this task's Sidereal-eligibility rule (Sidereals cannot learn Solar Circle sorcery).

name: Glance of the Unconquered Sun
summary: Level One sample Hearthstone (Solar Type) from Savant and Sorcerer's illustrative catalog: an inconspicuous clear gem that lets its bearer see through darkness as if lit by midday sun for a few moments.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: staring through the gem. For a few moments, the bearer can see everything as if it were illuminated by the sun's light at midday, letting her clearly assess what lies ahead of her in a darkened place.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. This is one of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level One', printed p. 67 (PDF 68). This book's own text explicitly frames its Hearthstone list as illustrative samples ('Storytellers should use these as guidelines to devise their own Manses'), distinct from Book of Three Circles' larger 'long roll of Hearthstones' catalog (cited in this book's own intro sidebar as the one piece of Book of Three Circles content not reprinted here); both catalogs are inventoried since neither supersedes the other.

name: The Labyrinthine Eye
summary: Level One sample Hearthstone (Water Type): a gem of glimmering brown and gold bands that leads its bearer along the fastest route out of a maze, labyrinth, or building.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: concentration. At each junction while lost in a maze, labyrinth, or building, the bearer senses the correct way toward the fastest path out; the stone guarantees only the shortest route, not the safest one.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level One', printed p. 67 (PDF 68).

name: Stone of Circulation
summary: Level One sample Hearthstone (Fire Type): a translucent green gem that regulates the bearer's temperature and circulation and helps ward off dehydration, hypothermia, and frostbite in extreme climates.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: none, constant. Boosts the bearer's immune system and helps regulate body temperature and circulation in harsh climates; it is only an aid to survival, not a full defense against the weather. The bearer gains one extra die on Stamina + Resistance rolls triggered by weather conditions.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level One', printed pp. 67-68 (PDF 68-69).

name: Gemstone of Surface Thoughts
summary: Level Two sample Hearthstone (Air Type): a round, light-blue gem that lets its bearer read a target's surface thoughts by concentrating on her.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: concentration. The bearer concentrates on a target and the player rolls Perception + Awareness; more successes yield clearer information (one success gives only words or a short phrase, while four or more successes give a detailed idea of what the target is thinking).
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level Two', printed p. 68 (PDF 69).

name: Snakeskin Stone
summary: Level Two sample Hearthstone (Lunar Type): a strange, almost flat rock patterned like red, black, and white scales that sloughs off the bearer's injured skin overnight to reveal fresh, pristine flesh.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: sleep. When the injured bearer sleeps, his skin sloughs off during the night, healing half of any lethal damage (rounded up) and all bashing damage suffered, though the stone cannot heal aggravated damage or internal-organ injuries; Lunar tattoos and other permanent markings persist on the fresh skin beneath.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones, not unique to Sidereals -- the 'Lunar' Type label describes the stone's Theme/flavor, not an eligibility restriction to Lunar Exalted.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level Two', printed p. 68 (PDF 69).

name: Sphere of Balance
summary: Level Two sample Hearthstone (Earth Type): a dark green gemstone flecked with white that grants the bearer perfect balance.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: none, constant. Removes two dice from any attempt made to knock the bearer over, and grants the bearer's player two extra dice on any roll involving the character's balance, such as walking along a narrow wall or balancing on an opponent's shoulders.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level Two', printed p. 68 (PDF 69). This is the last of the Level Two sample stones.

name: The Ever-Open Eye
summary: Level Three sample Hearthstone (Sidereal Type): a dull, gray, uninspiring gem that lets an Exalt stay awake indefinitely without tiredness or deterioration of her physical or mental abilities, at the risk of hallucinations and derangement from prolonged use.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: none, constant. The bearer never feels tired nor suffers any deterioration of her physical or mental abilities from lack of sleep. For every full day she remains awake after the first two days, her player must make a Stamina + Endurance roll each day, difficulty 1 for the first week, 2 for the second week, and so on. Failure causes hallucinations and waking nightmares that pass after a single night's sleep. A botch inflicts a temporary derangement lasting as long as she had been continuously awake using the stone before the botch.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones -- notably given the 'Sidereal' Type label, making it thematically apt for this splat, though it is not restricted to Sidereal Exalted.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level Three', printed pp. 68-69 (PDF 69-70).

name: Gemstone of Perfect Passage
summary: Level Three sample Hearthstone (Wood Type): a shimmering brown stone that causes doors, windows, gates, trapdoors, and other points of entry or exit to open at the bearer's touch.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: contact. Any door, window, gate, trapdoor, or other point of entry or exit opens with a touch from the bearer; it is useless on locked boxes, chains, or shackles, and on locks bound shut with Essence.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones, not unique to Sidereals.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level Three', printed p. 69 (PDF 70).

name: Hearth's Fire
summary: Level Three sample Hearthstone (Fire Type): a deep orange-and-red crystal that bursts into a warm campfire the instant it is placed on the ground, regardless of weather.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: touching the Hearthstone to the ground (reflexive). Creates a fire roughly two meters in diameter, burning hot enough to keep a dozen people warm and dry and to cook their food in even the worst conditions; it burns until struck by sunlight the following dawn. compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones, not unique to Sidereals.

name: Gem of Life
summary: Level Five sample Hearthstone (Earth Type): a smooth, black, iridescent stone that grants its bearer the extended lifespan of a Celestial Exalt, halting aging and the infirmities of old age for as long as she holds it and remains attuned to its Manse.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: none, constant. The bearer does not age and does not suffer the infirmities and illnesses of old age, even if she was already old when she acquired the stone; she cannot die of old age or illness while bearing it, but can still be harmed and killed through other means. If she loses attunement to the Manse or stops bearing the Hearthstone, she resumes aging normally.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones; the source text's example specifically describes a Dragon-Blood bearer gaining a Celestial Exalt's lifespan, but nothing in the stone's description restricts its Trigger/Expression by the wearer's Exalt type, so it is inventoried as usable by any Exalt (including Sidereals) who holds it -- flagged here rather than assumed silently.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level Five', printed p. 70 (PDF 71).

name: Home's Hearth
summary: Level Five sample Hearthstone (Sidereal Type): an irregular, multicolored gemstone that instantly teleports the bearer and up to five chosen companions to or from his Manse's Hearthroom from anywhere in Creation, notably used by all three of the Sidereals' hidden Manses.
requirements: Manse Background (see manse-background-altered); attunement to the Manse that produced this Hearthstone.
mechanics: Trigger: concentration. The bearer and up to five other people of his choice can instantly travel from anywhere in Creation to the Manse's Hearthroom, or leave the Hearthroom for a destination within 100 miles of the Manse; the transit is instantaneous and unaffected by distance or time. The effect is less reliable from the Wyld: the bearer's player must make a Wits + Occult roll to safely transport from the Wyld to the Manse. Failure drops the travelers into a random place within the Wyld, and a botch renders the stone useless for 48 hours while its Essence recharges.
compatibility: Any Sidereal Exalted holding a Manse Background and attuned to a Manse that produces this Hearthstone. One of Savant and Sorcerer's own explicitly labeled 'sample' Hearthstones -- given the 'Sidereal' Type label and the book's own note that all three of the Sidereals' hidden Manses use a Home's Hearth, this stone is especially thematically apt for this splat.
notes: Chapter Three: Demesne and Manse, 'Sample Hearthstones' -> 'Level Five', printed pp. 70-71 (PDF 71-72). This is the last of Savant and Sorcerer's 15 sample Hearthstones (3 per level x 5 levels), closing out this book's illustrative Hearthstone catalog; the book itself notes this list is a guideline for Storytellers rather than an exhaustive catalog, and its own intro sidebar points to Book of Three Circles' Chapter Six 'long roll of Hearthstones' as the more comprehensive (and not superseded) catalog, reviewed separately in this same pass.

name: Artifact Rating Framework (Power, Usefulness, Game Impact, Script Immunity, Drawback)
summary: GM-facing rules framework for rating any artifact on the standard five-dot Background scale by averaging four sub-ratings (Power, Usefulness, Game Impact, Script Immunity) and subtracting extra Drawback.
requirements: Storyteller/artificer-player collaboration; used whenever adjudicating an existing artifact's Background cost or designing a new one.
mechanics: Each aspect is rated 1-5 (Drawback is separate): Power measures raw effectiveness (bonus dice, Charm-duplication tier, up to Power 5 duplicating Essence 5-6 Charms including perfect effects, and N/A 'World-Shattering' artifacts that only lesser artifacts or legendary beings can resist); Usefulness measures how broadly applicable the item is, from Very Limited Use (••) up to Always Active (•••••), reduced by one or two dots for items usable only once or a limited number of times per story; Game Impact measures how much the artifact would disrupt the ongoing story/series, from None (•) to Changing (•••••); Script Immunity measures how protected from loss/destruction the item is by narrative convention, from None (•) to Total (•••••, enduring into the next Age). Weapons and armor use a simplified Power calculation: average the Resources cost of the mundane base item with the Power of any added abilities. To calculate final Artifact rating: add Power + Game Impact + Usefulness + Script Immunity, subtract any Drawback points taken above the minimum (which equals Power), then divide by four and round up.
compatibility: Storyteller and player tool for any Exalt designing, rating, or adjudicating an artifact; not a player-facing trait in itself.
notes: Chapter Two: Artifice and Enchantment, 'Artifact Levels' -> 'Power'/'Usefulness'/'Game Impact'/'Script Immunity'/'Calculating the Artifact Rating', printed pp. 23-29 (PDF 24-30). Two worked examples (a Power •• daiklave, a Power •• mask) are given but not separately inventoried; the mask example matches the 'Mask' sample artifact inventoried below.

name: Artifact Drawback Types and Alternate Power Sources
summary: GM-facing rules for the four Drawback subtypes (Essence, Component, Maintenance, Notoriety) that offset an artifact's cost, plus alternate ways to power an artifact besides direct Essence expenditure (Hearthstones, Essence Accumulators, Energy Taps, blood/life sacrifices).
requirements: Storyteller/artificer-player collaboration during artifact design or adjudication.
mechanics: Essence Drawback (X to +•••••) scales an artifact's mote requirement from normal up to 20x normal (Essence Glutton); reduced by installing a Hearthstone (lowers Drawback by the Hearthstone's level), an Essence Accumulator (a separate artifact acting like a Hearthstone of its own Artifact-rating level), an Energy Tap (built two Artifact levels below the Hearthstone-equivalence it grants, tied to a violent natural phenomenon like a volcano or whirlpool), or blood/life sacrifices (one health level of blood per use lowers Drawback by •, a mortal's life by ••, an Essence-wielder's death by •••). Component Drawback (X to •••••) scales the number of exotic ingredients required, from a trace of one Magical Material up to 10 rare exotic components. Maintenance Drawback requires Lore/Occult at least equal to its rating to service; unmaintained artifacts lose 10% speed/maneuverability, 2L/4B damage or soak, or one Power dot per 10 hours in arrears, persisting (and potentially becoming permanent) until repaired; large artifacts may need a repair team led by a Charisma + Presence roll (difficulty = team size / 3). Notoriety Drawback (X to •••••) scales how well-known and legally/socially fraught the artifact's possession is, from Unknown up to Anathema (feared and hunted by multiple powerful factions).
compatibility: Storyteller and player tool for any Exalt designing an artifact; not a player-facing trait in itself.
notes: Chapter Two: Artifice and Enchantment, 'Drawback' -> 'Essence Drawback'/'Alternate Power Sources'/'Component Drawback'/'Notoriety Drawback'/'Maintenance Drawback', printed pp. 26-33 (PDF 27-34). The three Personal/Larger/Massive Artifact Attunement-and-Activation mote tables (printed p. 26/PDF 27) were not transcribed row-by-row; they set baseline Essence costs by Power level and artifact scale.

name: Making an Artifact: the Five-Step Creation Process
summary: GM-facing rules for player characters constructing a new artifact from scratch in the Age of Sorrows: prerequisites, the five-step process (Design, Tools and Assistants, Components, Construction, Finishing Up), and notes on assembly-line mass production of low-level items.
requirements: Craft •••, Lore ••• and Occult ••• minimum to attempt any artifact creation.
mechanics: Step One (Design): four methods -- Design from Existing Plans (Lore 4+ per Artifact level), Design from Reconstruction (Intelligence + Investigation research through ruins/libraries, difficulty = Artifact rating + 2, 3+ successes per level), Design from Existing Example (Intelligence + Occult to study or disassemble an existing artifact, difficulty = rating + 3, botching disassembly causes an explosion dealing 10L per Artifact level), or Design from First Principles (three parallel Intelligence + Lore/Occult/Craft rolls, difficulty = rating + 4, 5 successes per level each). Step Two (Tools and Assistants): workshop quality reduces difficulty (basic +4/+3 to base difficulty depending on tools, advanced workshop +2, Shogunate-era +1, First Age +0), plus bonuses for assistants (thaumaturges, Terrestrial or Celestial Exalted artisans, summoned demons/elementals scaled via the Scope system); the Merit: Starting Workshop and the 'Workshops of Creation' survey of notable real-world workshops (Heptagram, Lookshy, the Great Houses, Yu-Shan, the Deathlords) are covered as separate rows/notes. Step Three (Components): most artifacts need only a scrap of a Magical Material; more exotic components scale with the desired Artifact rating (typically the artifact's rating minus one). Step Four (Construction): a series of Intelligence + Craft rolls (one per season) accumulating successes per an Artifact-Level-to-Base-Difficulty-and-Successes-Required table (Level 1: difficulty 3/10 successes, up to Level 5: difficulty 7/250 successes); the maker commits Essence equal to the Artifact rating throughout, forfeiting the artifact if withdrawn, and botches trigger escalating catastrophes (destroyed components, lost progress, design flaws, Essence-bound fate, or explosions). Step Five (Finishing Up): committed Essence returns on completion; repeating a similar item reduces required successes by 5 per repetition (to a floor). Mass production of Artifact • (and sometimes ••) items is possible via an assembly line: halve the item's Resources cost through enough prototypes, then succeed at an Intelligence + Lore roll (difficulty = rating + 2) to build a production station (cost = rating + 3 Resources per station, rating + 2 Resources per season to maintain) that lets mortal thaumaturges enchant items via Intelligence + Craft rolls.
compatibility: Any Exalt (or, for some steps, cooperating groups of Exalted/mortals) attempting to build a new artifact.
notes: Chapter Two: Artifice and Enchantment, 'Making an Artifact' -> 'The First Step: Design' through 'The Fifth Step: Finishing Up' plus 'In-Game Creation' introduction, printed pp. 29-34 (PDF 30-35). The detailed Workshop-difficulty/assistant-bonus tables and the 'Workshops of Creation' setting survey (printed p. 33/PDF 34) were paraphrased rather than transcribed table-row-by-row.

name: In-Game Creation: the Sidereal Exalted
summary: Sidereal-specific artifact-creation notes: how the Chosen of the Maidens historically used Craft Charms and Sidereal astrology to ease artifact construction, and why Sidereals build the fewest artifacts of any Celestial Exalted in the Age of Sorrows despite excellent workshop access.
requirements: Sidereal Exalted attempting artifact creation; interacts with the standard five-step process (see artifact-creation-five-step-process).
mechanics: In the First Age, Sidereals eased artifact creation with Craft Charms and Sidereal astrology: Excellent Implementation of Objectives (see Exalted: The Sidereals, p. 144) smoothed planning for large-scale works needing vast resources/laborers, while Implicit Construction Methodology (see Exalted: The Sidereals, p. 145) could remove any chance of mishap during construction entirely, though it was usable only by the Chosen of Serenity and only sparingly. Sidereals petitioned to aid a project they were not personally leading could use astrology (prayers to the pattern spiders) to grant a -1 target number to relevant Intelligence + Craft rolls and/or to rolls organizing assistants/workers. In the Age of Sorrows, Sidereals create the fewest artifacts of any Celestial Exalted: starmetal is exceptionally hard to obtain (see hearthstone/magical-materials notes) and few Sidereals are naturally drawn to artifice, so most simply improve themselves through Charms instead of building lasting tools. They do, however, have access to some of Creation's best workshops -- the Bronze Faction has the Heptagram, and both Factions can reach Yu-Shan's facilities (access scaling with the Exalt's standing in Heaven) -- making a Shogunate-standard workshop (or better, with Bureau of Destiny connections) realistically obtainable. Materials scarcity and Paradox risk from flagrant astrology use mean this route is used cautiously rather than routinely.
compatibility: Sidereal Exalted specifically; this section exists as this splat's counterpart to the chapter's per-Exalt-type 'In-Game Creation' notes for Terrestrial, Lunar, Abyssal, and Solar Exalted (not independently inventoried here as out of scope for this splat).
notes: Chapter Two: Artifice and Enchantment, 'In-Game Creation' -> 'The Sidereal Exalted', printed p. 35 (PDF 36), immediately following the parallel 'The Terrestrial Exalted' subsection and preceding 'The Lunar Exalted'/'The Abyssal Exalted'/'The Solar Exalted', none of which are in scope for the Sidereal inventory.
